entries.text: [3-Block Compose Designer](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeDesigner) and [UI](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ui): for 3-Block Compose 2.0.0, describe the layout preview inside the AutoJs6 editor (the "Preview" switch on the toolbar, tapping a widget to jump to its source line, bindings evaluated only in a safe scope) and the "Open in 3-Block Compose designer" entry; the required AutoJs6 version is now written as 6.8.0 or later

[async/await and continuation](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/asyncAwait): async functions, async generators and for await in the Rhino engine, when the callbacks of the built-in Promise run, working with continuation, threads, unhandled rejections, and the notice when a script ends.

[ImguiSession.once](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiSessionType?id=m-once): clarify version differences: plugin 1.18.0 and earlier pass only the event object to listeners; from 1.18.1, `(event, session)` is passed, as with on

[events.broadcast](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/events?id=m-emit): objects and arrays can be passed directly between Node.js / Bun main scripts and Rhino scripts; document the rules for functions, `undefined` and circular references, and shorten the corresponding Broadcast values cell on the [ImGui](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imgui) page
[TerminalSession.waitFor](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminalSessionType?id=m-waitfor): in Node.js / Bun, starting the wait before writing avoids missing output that is echoed very quickly

[Runtime APIs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtimeApis?id=相对路径): when a plugin process is denied access to shared storage, AutoJs6 prompts once and can open system settings; document the permissions required by Bun.file and node:fs in Bun

Complete [ImGui](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imgui) reference: quick start, sessions and window modes, call timing, units, threads, errors and limitations, all function and constant groups, a PascalCase alias table, and object pages for [ImguiSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiSessionType), [ImguiDrawList](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiDrawListType), [ImguiFloatingButton](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiFloatingButtonType), [ImguiComponent](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiComponentType), [ImguiDataTable](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiDataTableType), [ImguiLogWindow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiLogWindowType), [ImguiToast](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiToastType), [ImguiStatsOverlay](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiStatsOverlayType), [ImguiDialog](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiDialogType), [ImguiDialogPromise](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiDialogPromiseType), [ImguiTexture](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiTextureType), [ImguiSelectionStorage](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiSelectionStorageType) and [ImguiMultiSelectIO](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imguiMultiSelectIOType); the content covers ImGui plugin 1.18.0, with pages added to the sidebar and contents

Model update instructions for [Speech](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/speech?id=模型更新); [SpeechModelInfo](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/speechModelInfoType) gains [updateAvailable](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/speechModelInfoType?id=p-updateavailable) and [latestVersionCode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/speechModelInfoType?id=p-latestversioncode) (3-Macaw Speech 1.4.0 or later)

[ImGui](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imgui): the runtime support table states that Node.js and Bun do not provide the imgui module; add [Using Node.js / Bun](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/imgui?id=在-node-js-bun-中使用), using engines.execScript to launch a Rhino script that opens a window and events.broadcast for communication

[Class Syntax](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/classSyntax): class syntax supported by the Rhino engine, subclassing built-in types, syntax and limitations for extending Java classes and interfaces, the relationship with JavaAdapter, and the requirement that the Proxy set trap return true in strict mode.

[Flow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flowType) and [Runtime APIs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtimeApis?id=根方法与-flow-对象): Flow objects in Node.js, Workers and Bun gain await() and sync(timeout); both return a Promise without blocking the script thread, written as `await chain.sync()`; exceeding timeout rejects with TIMEOUT while the flow continues running, as in Rhino

In [OcrOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType), [profile](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-profile) and [mergeLine](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-mergeline): add seven new PP-OCRv3 language packages and explain Arabic reading order and recognition limitations for Devanagari and other scripts.

[Runtime APIs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtimeApis?id=相对路径): relative paths for zip, files.open and files.toFile in Node.js and Bun resolve against the script source directory, as in Rhino, instead of a plugin-private directory inaccessible to the host. Node.js engines.myEngine() gains hostCwd.

[Runtime APIs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtimeApis?id=node-js-bun-worker-的主题色-相册与批量重命名): colors.theme, gallery and files.batchRename in Node.js and Bun all return Promises, with separate capabilities and permissions. speech in Node.js and Bun gains diarize, detectLanguage, tag and speech.speaker

[OcrOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType): OCR methods in Node.js and Bun accept the same options, meanings and defaults as Rhino, including [mergeLine](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-mergeline).

Node.js and Bun recognition results for [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr) include the [extras](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dataTypes?id=p-extras) property and accept the [useOpenCL](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-useopencl) option.

In [Threads](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/threads), [threads.pool](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/threads?id=m-pool): `maxPoolSize` of `0` (including the default) imposes no upper limit, and `corePoolSize` accepts any nonnegative integer.

In [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr), recognition result [OcrResult](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dataTypes?id=ocrresult): the [extras](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dataTypes?id=p-extras) property exposes engine-provided information such as `executionProvider` and `quad`; [OcrOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType) gains the [useCls](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-usecls) option

In [OcrOptions](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType), [variant](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-variant), [profile](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-profile), [useSlim](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-useslim) and [useOpenCL](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocrOptionsType?id=p-useopencl): PP-OCRv3 switches to ONNX Runtime; select the Paddle Lite edition with `variant: "v3-paddle-lite"`, and `profile` participates in plugin matching

Runtime support tables on [UI](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ui), [Console](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/console), [Floaty](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/floaty), [Web](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/web), [Terminal](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminal), [3-Block Compose (Compose)](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/compose), [ComposeNode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeNodeType), [ComposeSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeSessionType), [ComposeFloatyWindow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeFloatyWindowType), [ComposeState](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeStateType), [WebSocket](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/webSocketType), [InjectableWebView](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/injectableWebViewType) and [InjectableWebClient](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/injectableWebClientType): the Bun host client now shares UI code with Node.js, providing ui content windows and window members (ui.layout permission), host.floaty floating windows (new floaty.control permission, plus floaty.raw for raw windows and floaty.touch for touch passthrough), host.web WebSocket (using Bun's own connection, no permission required) and injectable WebView (ui.layout), host.terminal sessions (new terminal.control permission, not implied by shell), host.console rawInput / input and the build configurator (console.control), and compose ComposeError and node members (ui.compose); the new permissions are off by default and enabled separately in Plugin Center's Bun settings

Runtime support tables on [UI](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ui), [Console](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/console), [Toast](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/toast), [Floaty](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/floaty), [Web](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/web), [Terminal](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/terminal), [3-Block Compose (Compose)](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/compose), [ComposeNode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeNodeType), [ComposeSession](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeSessionType), [ComposeFloatyWindow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeFloatyWindowType), [ComposeState](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeStateType), [WebSocket](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/webSocketType), [InjectableWebView](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/injectableWebViewType), [InjectableWebClient](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/injectableWebClientType) and [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global): the Node.js main thread and Workers now provide ui content windows (layout / layoutFile / setContentView / finish, directly usable XML ids, Back and lifecycle events, custom registerWidget controls, double-brace bindings, and window members such as status/navigation bar colors and heights), floaty windows (window / rawWindow and window position, size, focus and closing), web WebSocket (newWebSocket with the same events as Rhino) and injectable WebView, terminal sessions and visible execution (requires the new terminal capability, not implied by shell), console rawInput / input (returning Promises) and the build configurator, toast dismissAll and logged notifications such as toastLog, compose ComposeError and node type / parent / children plus shorthand properties such as w / h / bg; these globals (isUiThread, toastLog and others, newWebSocket and others, ComposeError) are available on both the main thread and Workers. ui.layoutInflater is a Rhino Java object marked nonportable; use ui.inflate / ui.createView instead

Runtime support tables on [Automator](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/automator), [Events](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/events), [Threads](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/threads), [Continuation](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/continuation), [Timers](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/timers), [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr), [YOLO](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/yolo), [QR Code](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/qrcode), [Barcode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/barcode), [UiSelector](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/uiSelectorType), [Flow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flow) and [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global): Bun now provides host.automator and host.auto through its host client (accessibility.control permission, sharing the Node.js implementation; gestures additionally require accessibility.gesture, service start/stop, modes, flags and cache clearing require accessibility.service, automator.captureScreen requires screen.capture, and auto.dump / auto.explain use accessibility.control), Rhino members of events (local emitters with events.observe, key-name/notification/Toast observation with events.key / events.notification / events.toast, touch observation with events.touch, key interception with events.key.intercept), host.threads / host.continuation (local implementations including VolatileDispose), host.timers keepAlive / loop / setIntervalExt (local implementations; six methods including timers.setTimeout use Bun's own timers, with scheduled-task members in host.tasks), host.ocr modes and fixed engines, host.barcode / host.qrcode, host.yolo and YoloDetector, host.selector pickup / detect / existsOne / existsAll (accessibility.control), and host.global sleep / wait (wait.async) and automator global actions (installed into globalThis by host.global.install(), without replacing existing globals); new Bun permissions, off by default, are accessibility.service, events.touch, events.key.intercept (not implied by parent permissions), ocr.control, barcode.control (shared with qrcode) and yolo.control

Runtime support tables on [Automator](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/automator), [Events](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/events), [Threads](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/threads), [Continuation](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/continuation), [Timers](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/timers), [Keys](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/keys), [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr), [YOLO](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/yolo), [QR Code](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/qrcode), [Barcode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/barcode), [UiSelector](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/uiSelectorType), [Flow](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/flow) and [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global): the Node.js main thread and Workers now provide automator actions and global actions (click / longClick / press / swipe / gesture* accept Rhino argument forms, with coordinates scaled by setScreenMetrics), auto service management, modes/flags/window filtering, window queries and accessibility events (auto.waitFor timeout ends the entire execution, as in Rhino), Rhino members of events (sticky events, key names and interception, touch and cross-script broadcasts), threads (asynchronous tasks on the current thread, atomic / lock transferable to Workers, VolatileDispose, sync), continuation, timers keepAlive / setIntervalExt, yolo.load and YoloDetector, ocr modes and fixed engines, keys keycodes, qrcode, selector pickup / detect / existsOne / existsAll, and global sleep / wait (wait.async); new capabilities accessibility.service, events.key.intercept and events.touch are not implied by their parent capabilities

Runtime support tables on [Device](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/device), [Sensors](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/sensors) and [Media](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/media): the Node.js main thread and Workers now provide all device members (Build fields and buildDisplay / baseOS / securityPatch / codename, pageSize, getMarketName, manufacturers / brands / roms checks, digest, isManufacturer, keepAwake and keepScreenOn / keepScreenDim with optional duration, vibrate duration-array and Morse-code overloads, cancelVibration, wakeUpIfNeeded, screen/power/network queries, and rotation / orientation / imei / serial), Rhino-style sensors event emitters (register / unregister / unregisterAll / getSensor, four sensors.delay levels, ignoresUnsupportedSensor and Rhino's 12 sensor names), and media playMusic / pauseMusic / resumeMusic / stopMusic / musicSeekTo / isMusicPlaying / getMusicDuration / getMusicCurrentPosition / scanFile (autojs6:media module); getIMEI / getSerial / getAndroidId / getMacAddress / getSharedDeviceId and imei / serial require the new device.identifiers capability, not implied by device

Runtime support tables on [Device](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/device), [Sensors](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/sensors) and [Media](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/media): Bun now provides all device members through its host client (Build fields, width / height, density, pageSize, digest, getMarketName, isManufacturer and manufacturers / brands / roms checks come from the startup snapshot with device.info permission; screen/power/network queries, keepAwake / keepScreenDim, vibrate duration-array and Morse-code overloads, cancelVibration, wakeUpIfNeeded and rotation / orientation use device.control), Rhino-style sensors event emitters (register / unregister / unregisterAll / getSensor and four sensors.delay levels), and new host.media (eight playback members including playMusic plus scanFile, and playback sessions with play / pause / resume / stop / seekTo / getPlaybackStatus); new Bun permissions, off by default, are device.identifiers (getIMEI / getSerial / getAndroidId / getMacAddress / getSharedDeviceId and imei / serial), media.control (playback) and media.library (scanFile)

The Official plugin tools table in [Plugins](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/plugins?id=官方插件工具表) lists the 15 tools supplied by 3-Hanzi CC, AutoJs6 YOLO NCNN, Image Quantization, 3-Stack Archive and 3-Macaw Speech (opencc_convert, yolo_detect, imagequant_quantize, archive_list / archive_read / archive_extract, speech_listen, speech_speak, speech_transcribe, speech_synthesize, speech_speaker_verify, speech_speaker_identify, speech_diarize, speech_detect_language and speech_tag); each documents its purpose, provider plugin, minimum plugin version, parameters (types, required status and defaults), result fields and file or directory output

The imagequant_quantize example for plugins.tools.call in [Plugins](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/plugins?id=m-toolscall): replace parameter colors with the actual maxColors and output image with the actual png (the original example was rejected by parameter validation)

Runtime support tables on [AutoJs6](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/autojs), [Installer](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/installer), [Memory](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/memory), [Settings](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/settings), [SysProps](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/sysprops), [Power Manager](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/powerManager), [Notice](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/notice), [Work Manager](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/workManager), [Engines](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/engines), [Plugins](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/plugins), [Dialogs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dialogs), [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global) and [App](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/app): Bun now provides through its host client autojs (including autojs.version and R), installer, memory, settings, sysprops, powerManager, notice isEnabled / ensureEnabled / launchSettings / config / builder / getBuilder and notice.channel, workManager (mapped to host.tasks), engines (host view, with myEngine representing the current execution), plugins.extend / extendAll / extendAllBut and plugins.tools, dialogs.build, app.autojs, and host.global currentPackage / currentActivity / currentComponent, waitForActivity / waitForPackage, exit / stop, isStopped and others, requiresApi / requiresAutojsVersion, setScreenMetrics, WIDTH / HEIGHT and isAutoJs6; enable the corresponding permissions in Plugin Center (off by default): autojs.control / autojs.manage, settings.control / settings.write, sysprops.control, memory.control / memory.dump, installer.control / installer.mutate, engines.control / engines.exec, plugintools.control (also lists and calls tools from user-authorized plugins, as in Rhino); notice uses notifications.post / notifications.settings and powerManager uses device.control / device.power. memory.watch is inapplicable in Bun (equivalents are heapStats / generateHeapSnapshot in bun:jsc); autojs.getRootMode returns the same RootMode object as Rhino, and notice.channel uses the script filename if id is omitted; system globals and R also become global variables after host.global.install() (called separately in each thread); exit / stop in a Worker end the entire execution, and exit(error) fails it with that error

Runtime support tables on [AutoJs6](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/autojs), [Installer](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/installer), [Memory](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/memory), [Settings](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/settings), [SysProps](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/sysprops), [Power Manager](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/powerManager), [Notice](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/notice), [Work Manager](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/workManager), [Engines](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/engines), [Plugins](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/plugins), [Dialogs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dialogs), [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global) and [App](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/app): the Node.js main thread and Workers now provide autojs (including autojs.version and R), installer, memory, settings, sysprops and powerManager (modules autojs6:autojs / autojs6:installer / autojs6:memory / autojs6:settings / autojs6:sysprops / autojs6:power_manager), notice isEnabled / ensureEnabled / launchSettings / config / builder / getBuilder and notice.channel, workManager (mapped to tasks), all engines members (all / stopAll use the host view; execAutoFile / stopAllAndToast / getEngines added), plugins.extend / extendAll / extendAllBut and plugins.tools, dialogs.build, app.autojs, and globals currentPackage / currentActivity / currentComponent, waitForActivity / waitForPackage, exit / stop, isStopped and others, requiresApi / requiresAutojsVersion, setScreenMetrics, WIDTH / HEIGHT and isAutoJs6 (autojs6:system module, also globals as in Rhino); capabilities are declared per module (autojs, settings, sysprops, memory, installer, with write operations under .control / .write / .dump / .mutate declared separately); memory.watch is inapplicable in Node.js (equivalent: FinalizationRegistry)

Runtime support table on [Util](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/util): util.class, util.className and util.getClassName read the class of Java objects wrapped by Rhino; values in Node.js and Bun are not Java objects, so all three are marked inapplicable (Java object required); the equivalent is getClass on a java module handle

In [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr), recognition result [OcrResult](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/dataTypes?id=ocrresult): add text (same as label) and compareTo (compares two results in reading order for sorting), and change confidence to number (0 to 1); [ComposeNode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeNodeType?id=快捷属性访问器) gains a Shorthand property accessors section for the eight read/write properties w / h / padding / bg / weight / alpha / testTag / contentDescription; runtime support tables on [3-Block Compose (Compose)](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/compose), [ComposeModifier](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeModifierType), [ComposeNode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/composeNodeType), [OCR](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/ocr) and [Barcode](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/barcode) add 55 component functions, 20 modifiers, eight shorthand properties and the members of OcrResult and WrappedBarcode

Execution modes in [Runtime APIs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtimeApis?id=执行方式): Node.js scripts and projects have no execution time limit by default (as with Rhino); node.timeoutMs in project.json is the total execution budget (from receipt by the plugin, including queuing and workspace preparation, reporting ERR_AUTOJS6_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT when exhausted), and output is forwarded to the console in chunks during execution; the WebView waiting section is updated accordingly

Runtime-owned interfaces in [Runtime APIs](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/runtimeApis?id=运行时自有接口): grouped entries provided by the Node.js, Bun and QuickJS plugins that do not map to host modules (113 entries in 12 Node.js groups: host bridge and messages, lifecycle checkpoints, capability snapshots, npm and package_manager, native plugins, rhino and autojs6:compat, media_store and the WorkerPool worker pool; 12 Bun client entries; QuickJS console, print and scriptArgs), each with signature, purpose, runtime and minimum plugin version; also explain script argument access (QuickJS scriptArgs contains only the script filename, Node.js and Bun use process.argv, and Rhino uses engines.myEngine().execArgv)

[Python Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/pythonRuntime), [Java Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/javaRuntime), [Kotlin Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/kotlinRuntime) and [Lua Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/luaRuntime) describe the APIs supplied to scripts by these four language runtime plugins: Python's autojs6 package (46 functions, 54 constants and 10 exception classes), the JVM Entry API shared by Java and Kotlin (seven types and 17 methods for Java, six types and 13 methods excluding args and clipboard for Kotlin), and Lua's autojs module (11 functions and read-only arguments); each item includes a signature, description and example in its language; [AutoJs4 Runtime](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/autojs4Runtime) gains an Upstream APIs and differences guide subsection, and [Plugins](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/plugins) links to these four pages

Bun columns in runtime support tables on [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/color), [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/colorType), [Files](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/files), [Zip](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/zip), [Storages](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/storages), [Storage](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/storageType), [EpubBook](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubBookType), [MIME](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mime), [Recorder](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/recorder) and [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global): Bun now provides colors / Color, files (including prototype members and global open), zip, mime, recorder, storages (including names / all and Storage#size), EpubBook#toString, and globals dayjs / pangu / cheerio / i18n; host operations in files require files.control, while zip, Zip and colors.toColorStateList / setPaintColor / extract require java.interop

Runtime support tables on [App](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/app), [Shell](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/shell), [Shizuku](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/shizuku) and [ShellProcess](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/shellProcessType): the Node.js main thread and Workers now provide app members (including dual-app helpers, getInstalledPackages / getApkInfo / getAppByAlias and sendLocalBroadcastSync), shell and shizuku members, 19 global key and gesture functions (Home / KeyCode / Tap and others), and ShellProcess members; corresponding Bun members require app.control / shell.control / shell.root / shell.shizuku

Offline analysis in [Speech](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/speech): speech.diarize (who spoke when, optionally identifying speakers from enrolled voiceprints), speech.detectLanguage (language identification), speech.tag (audio tagging) and their Async forms, plus speech.speaker recognition (enroll, verify, identify, list and remove voiceprints); the model catalog adds 3-Macaw Speech 1.3.0 speaker, segmentation, language identification and audio tagging models, and [SpeechModelInfo](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/speechModelInfoType) gains model kinds speaker, segment, langid and tagger

Runtime support tables on [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/color), [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/colorType), [Files](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/files), [Zip](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/zip), [Storages](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/storages), [Storage](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/storageType), [MediaInfo](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mediainfo), [EpubBook](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/epubBookType), [MIME](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/mime), [Recorder](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/recorder), [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global) and [Util](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/util): the Node.js main thread and Workers now provide colors / Color, files (including global open), zip, mime, recorder, storages (including names / all and Storage#size), mediainfo, globals dayjs / pangu / cheerio / i18n and axios in Workers; util.toRegularAndCall / toRegularAndApply are marked deprecated by the host

[Bundled Libraries](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/bundledLibraries), explaining that axios, cheerio, dayjs, i18n, pangu, lodash and the Node.js compatible modules are now provided by the Bundled Libraries plugin instead of the AutoJs6 package, how to install the plugin and switch individual libraries, the error thrown by require and the global objects when the plugin is unavailable, and how apps packaged by AutoJs6 take along the libraries their scripts use; the Modules, Global, Internationalization and Pangu pages are updated accordingly

Runtime support tables at the top of the remaining module and object type pages with script APIs (83 pages including the previous 13, covering all 69 modules and 43 returned object types), listing each API's entry point, status and permissions in Rhino, the Node.js main thread, Node.js Workers and Bun; module tables are followed by the returned objects documented there, while objects with their own type pages (such as [UiObject](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/uiObjectType) and [App](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/appType)) have tables on those pages; the table on [Global](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/global) incorporates species
Replace the nonexistent instance method openSettings in [App](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/appType) with the actual launchSettings (AutoJs6 has no openSettings)
Add the (components, alpha) overload for colors.rgba / hsva / hsla in [Color](https://docs.autojs6.com/#/color): an array of three components and a separately supplied alpha component
